selection: Every two-club MLB trade announced from the day after the previous World Series through the day before North American Opening Day. Excluded when it involves three or more clubs, a player to be named later, cash with no reported amount, international bonus pool space, a draft pick outside Competitive Balance Round B, or a minor leaguer with no FanGraphs FV published on or before the trade date. Rule fixed before any trade was scored.
searched_sources: 2024-10/11/12: Baseball-Reference 2024 transactions log (https://www.baseball-reference.com/leagues/majors/2024-transactions.shtml), every trade/purchase line from Oct 31 to Dec 31
2024-10/11/12: MLB Stats API transactions, typeCode TR, 2024-10-31 to 2024-12-31, sportId=1 and all sports (https://statsapi.mlb.com/api/v1/transactions?startDate=2024-10-31&endDate=2024-12-31)

Baseball-Reference 2025 transaction pages for all 30 clubs (https://www.baseball-reference.com/teams/{TEAM}/2025-transactions.shtml), filtered to 2025-01-01..2025-03-26 for trades, sales and purchases. Covers January, February and March 2025. Found the Shugart/McShane trade, which the Stats API feed lacks; every other trade matched the Stats API.
Cot's Baseball Contracts team pages archived on the Wayback Machine (Jan to Mar 2025) for contracts and service time, cross-checked against MLBTR's 2025 arbitration tracker values.
Cot's Baseball Contracts team pages via Wayback (Dec 2024 to Mar 2025) for service time and contracts; MLBTR 2025 arbitration tracker for cross-checking service time
FanGraphs The Board via Wayback captures 2024-11-09, 2024-11-26, 2024-12-11, 2024-12-13, 2024-12-20 plus 2023 and 2024 list pages (prospect FV)

FanGraphs WordPress API (blogs.fangraphs.com/wp-json/wp/v2/posts) searched by name for each traded minor leaguer, restricted to posts on or before the trade date, plus the FanGraphs Board snapshot of 2024-11-09, for FV grades.
FanGraphs blog posts Oct 30 to Dec 31, 2024 via the WordPress API (trade write-ups)
February 2025: both sources above plus MLB.com's Faedo trade story.
January 2025: both sources above plus MLB.com trade stories (Pressly, Rogers) and the FanGraphs trade write-ups (Lux, Cartaya, Pressly, Rogers).

MLB Stats API transactions feed (the data behind MLB.com's transactions pages), whole window 2025-01-01..2025-03-26, filtered to typeCode TR (80 rows, 42 distinct trades): https://statsapi.mlb.com/api/v1/transactions?startDate=2025-01-01&endDate=2025-03-26. Covers January, February and March 2025.
MLB Trade Rumors refused direct connections from this environment, so it was consulted only through search-result summaries (no MLBTR month archive pages were read).
MLB.com press releases and news articles per trade; MLB Stats API 2025 draft results for pick numbers

March 2025 (through 03-26, including Tokyo Series week): both sources above plus MLB.com stories and press releases (Jones/Freeman, Anderson/Suarez) and web searches for the Horn, Oduber and Schreffler returns.

trades.name: Ryan Pressly to Cubs for Juan Bello

left.name: Ryan Pressly
left.notes: Final year of 2-year/$30M extension (2023-24); the $14M 2025 mutual option ($2M buyout) became guaranteed when he met the appearance threshold, so 2025 is a guaranteed $14M. Full no-trade protection, waived for this deal. Jon Heyman (via theScore) reported the Cubs gave him a new full no-trade clause and an assignment bonus to cover the tax difference; the bonus amount was not reported. FanGraphs' write-up mentions a possible 2026 vest, but Cot's lists no 2026 option, so none is recorded. Service time from Cot's Baseball Contracts team page as archived on the Wayback Machine during the 2024-25 offseason (spot-checked: Cot's values on these snapshots match MLBTR's 2025 arbitration tracker for Skubal 4.114, Gomber 5.111, Feltner 2.143, Suarez 4.022).

left.name: Houston Astros pay $5.5M of Pressly's 2025 salary

trades.notes: Pressly waived his no-trade clause on Jan 26; the Cubs announced the trade on Jan 28. MLB.com: Chicago is responsible for $8.5M of the $14M 2025 salary, so Houston sends $5.5M (FanGraphs also reports $5.5M). Bello was No. 31 and 35+ FV on FanGraphs' Cubs list (published 2024-12-20).
